approx_top_k: exact top k, one row per value: SELECT x, count(*) AS c FROM t GROUP BY x ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT k (a full count, not a sketch)
histogram_numeric: GROUP BY width_bucket(col, min, max, n) with count(*) gives equal-width bucket counts (bucket numbers, not bin centres; col = max lands in bucket n+1); Spark's adaptive bins are not reproduced
hll_sketch_agg: approx_count_distinct(expr) returns the estimate directly; serialized HyperLogLog sketches are not available
hll_sketch_estimate: approx_count_distinct(expr) over the raw column returns the estimate; serialized HyperLogLog sketches are not available
java_method: Krishiv has no JVM to call into; register a UDF instead (see the Native Rust UDFs reference)
kll_sketch_agg_bigint: percentile_approx(col, p) returns the quantile directly; serialized KLL sketches are not available
kll_sketch_agg_double: percentile_approx(col, p) returns the quantile directly; serialized KLL sketches are not available
kll_sketch_agg_float: percentile_approx(col, p) returns the quantile directly; serialized KLL sketches are not available
kll_sketch_get_quantile_bigint: percentile_approx(col, p) over the raw column returns the quantile; serialized KLL sketches are not available
kll_sketch_get_quantile_double: percentile_approx(col, p) over the raw column returns the quantile; serialized KLL sketches are not available
kll_sketch_get_quantile_float: percentile_approx(col, p) over the raw column returns the quantile; serialized KLL sketches are not available
reflect: Krishiv has no JVM to call into; register a UDF instead (see the Native Rust UDFs reference)
sentences: for the words of one sentence: regexp_extract_all(str, '[A-Za-z0-9_]+', 0); Spark's sentence and word break rules are not reproduced
theta_sketch_agg: approx_count_distinct(expr) returns a distinct-count estimate; Theta sketches are not available
theta_sketch_estimate: approx_count_distinct(expr) over the raw column returns a distinct-count estimate; Theta sketches are not available
try_reflect: Krishiv has no JVM to call into; register a UDF instead (see the Native Rust UDFs reference)
window: tumbling windows, start only and whole seconds: group by timestamp_seconds(floor(unix_timestamp(ts) / N) * N) for N seconds; no window struct or end column
